title: The Iconic Dash -Top-Rated Victoria Pedicab Tour - 1 hr 4 people
blurb: Looking for a fun and relaxing way to see Victoria in just one hour? Our 1-Hour Scenic Victoria Pedicab Tour is the perfect introduction to the city. Sit back and enjoy a private ride as your local guide shares fascinating stories, local history, and insider knowledge while showcasing Victoria's beautiful natural scenery and stunning architecture.
